title: Customer-configurable stability contracts for pinned model variants
creator: Priya Kapoor
description: Enterprise customers frequently request the ability to pin specific model variants while contractually requiring stability guarantees (no unannounced upgrades, guaranteed rollback windows, and defined deprecation notice periods). This ticket proposes a stability-contract feature in the model catalog that lets customers declare a stability profile for pinned variants (e.g., 30/60/90-day stability windows), and exposes contract metadata to routing/rollback automation and the Console. Goals: 1) reduce inbound support/SE work for pin-related churn, 2) provide automation hooks for safe rollouts and emergency rollbacks, and 3) make deprecation timelines explicit to customers and SRE/Oncall. We will design the metadata model, UI surface in Console, API flags for Dedicated/Private customers, and a lightweight enforcement/alerting pipeline integrated with release automation and the rollback playbook.
acceptance_criteria: Catalog API accepts a stability_contract field for pinned model variants with enumerated profiles (none, short-30, medium-60, long-90) and validates inputs
Console shows stability contract on variant detail page and in the pinning modal with explanation text and customer-visible deprecation countdown
Routing/orchestration honors stability contracts: variants with active long contracts are excluded from automated canaries unless explicit override is provided
Oncall runbook includes automated alerts when a release would violate a stability contract and triggers a pre-release hold
Documentation (Confluence + API docs) and a customer-facing FAQ published before GA
Integration tests & end-to-end smoke tests added to catalog CI to prevent accidental breaks
